title: Custom3D Food Craft
description: Adds custom 3D food items to Minecraft with detailed models and immersive gameplay.
body:
Custom 3D Food Craft adds new 3D food items and crafting recipes to Minecraft.

Features:
- New custom foods
- High quality 3D models
- Special effects and abilities
- Survival friendly crafting recipes

This mod improves the food experience with detailed models and fun gameplay.
